title: Glass corner shower & freestanding tub
body: Frameless glass on two sides, cream ceramic stacked vertically to the ceiling, and a large-format stone-look floor carried unbroken under the freestanding tub.
alt: Corner glass shower in stacked cream tile beside a freestanding tub

title: Black gloss tub surround
body: Glossy black ceramic in a running bond wrapping three walls and the tub apron, white grout holding every line crisp against brass fittings.
alt: Alcove tub surrounded by glossy black subway tile with brass fixtures

title: Black gloss shower over tub
body: Full-height gloss black ceramic on every wall with a recessed niche, brass rain head and valve, and the original privacy window kept in place.
alt: Shower over tub tiled in glossy black subway with a recessed niche

title: White subway shower, brass slider
body: Running-bond white ceramic to the ceiling with dark grout, brass sliding door and shelves, and a black-and-white checkerboard pan echoed in the floor outside.
alt: White subway tile shower with a brass sliding glass door and checkerboard pan

title: Freestanding tub in marble-look slab
body: Book-matched porcelain slab across the walls with a wood slat return, polished porcelain floor, and a brass filler and handheld set beside the tub.
alt: Freestanding tub against marble-look porcelain slab walls and a wood slat panel

title: Gold-veined slab vanity wall
body: Full-height porcelain slab behind a double vanity, veining run continuously across the wall so no seam interrupts the pattern. Sconces mounted straight through the tile.
alt: Bathroom vanity wall clad in gold-veined marble-look porcelain slab

title: Black herringbone vanity wall
body: Glossy black ceramic set in a tight herringbone with white grout — the layout that costs the most labor per square foot and shows every millimetre of it.
alt: Black herringbone tile vanity wall with brass lighting and gold mirror

title: White subway, wall to wall
body: Running-bond ceramic carried across the full vanity wall and around the corner, courses kept level through the outside corner and the sconce boxes.
alt: White subway tile covering a full bathroom vanity wall and corner

title: Marble-look slab, double vanity
body: Grey-veined porcelain slab from counter to ceiling, panels matched at the seam and cut tight around the sconce and outlet boxes.
alt: Double vanity against a white marble-look porcelain slab wall

title: Powder room, dark glazed brick
body: Espresso glazed brick with the glaze variation left visible, run full height beside a wood slat panel and an arched brass mirror.
alt: Powder room wall in dark espresso glazed brick tile beside a wood slat panel

title: Vertical stacked kitchen backsplash
body: Ivory glazed ceramic stacked vertically from counter to cabinet, joints aligned right through the run, outlets cut in tight beneath the under-cabinet lighting.
alt: Kitchen backsplash in ivory glazed ceramic stacked vertically

title: Marble rosette mosaic backsplash
body: Waterjet marble mosaic run full height behind the sink and up through the shelf reveal, sheets aligned so the pattern never breaks at a seam.
alt: Kitchen backsplash in white marble rosette mosaic with floating wood shelves

title: Slab backsplash behind the range
body: Porcelain slab carried floor to ceiling behind the range and along the counter run, veining matched across the corner, with the pot filler cut in cleanly.
alt: Kitchen slab backsplash in marble-look porcelain behind a black range hood

title: Grey slab vanity wall
body: Grey stone-look porcelain run floor to ceiling behind a black double vanity, panels matched so the movement carries across the wall. Sconces and outlets cored straight through the tile.
alt: Bathroom vanity wall in grey stone-look porcelain with a black double vanity and brass sconces

title: Marble-look tub & shower surround
body: White marble-look porcelain wrapping three walls above the tub, veining matched across each joint, with a recessed niche framed flush and brass trim throughout.
alt: Tub and shower surround in white marble-look porcelain with a recessed niche and brass fixtures

title: Checkerboard entry floor
body: Black and white porcelain set on the diagonal, the layout centred on the door so the pattern lands symmetrically at both walls.
alt: Entry floor in black and white checkerboard porcelain set on the diagonal

title: Polished porcelain bath floor
body: Polished marble-look porcelain on the floor and walls in one run, with an LED reveal under the floating vanity and a wood slat wall behind the tub.
alt: Polished marble-look porcelain bathroom floor with a floating vanity

title: Bronze bath, wall to wall
body: Matte bronze porcelain carried across the vanity wall and around into the tub-shower in one run, with a recessed niche and a warm oak vanity set against it.
alt: Bathroom in matte bronze large-format porcelain with an oak vanity and arched brass mirrors

title: Marble-look fireplace surround
body: Porcelain slab surround with the veining run through the firebox opening and mitred at the returns, so no cut edge shows from the room.
alt: Living room fireplace surround clad in marble-look porcelain slab

title: Black marble slab powder room
body: Black porcelain slab with white veining run book-matched across the wall, cut tight to the sconce boxes so the pattern reads unbroken behind the mirror.
alt: Powder room wall in black marble-look porcelain slab with an ornate gold mirror

title: Black herringbone, full wall
body: Gloss black ceramic in a tight herringbone across the whole wall, white grout holding every line, with the window returns tiled in and a marble-look floor underneath.
alt: Bathroom wall in black herringbone tile with white grout, an oak vanity and marble-look floor
